answer.text: Park the motorcycle upright on a level surface.
Start the engine from cold, let it idle for 2 to 3 minutes, and then stop the engine.
Wait 2 to 3 minutes for the oil to settle, then check the oil level on the sight glass.
The oil level should be close to the MAX mark.
If it is not, top up the oil to MAX and repeat the procedure.
Do not fill above the MAX mark, as it may affect the clutch function.
